message.content: {"count":2,"rationale":"Deploy mfa:admin and mfa:dbadmin together. mfa:admin blocks authentication to both DC and ADFS, preventing their admin states. With those states unreachable, mfa:dbadmin blocks authentication to the database, fileserver, and backup, preventing every exfiltration technique. No single control suffices: segmentation alone is bypassed by phishing and escalating an unpatched workstation; mfa:admin alone leaves the CI-server credential-leak route open; mfa:dbadmin alone is bypassed through DC or ADFS admin access. Any other single control leaves the phishing → internal access → application authentication → Kerberoasting → DC admin → database exfiltration route available, using the laptop if workstation escalation is patched."}
